requirement:
Per-file uncovered obligations under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.gaps.details` MUST be collapsed
initially.
rationale:
The subject has one obligation: per-file uncovered-obligation details in the combined gaps overview MUST be collapsed initially.

The marked test `src/execution_coverage/check.rs#mod[tests]/fn[book_verdict_and_gaps_follow_the_native_policy_and_current_reviews]` covers it. It renders the real "Coverage gaps" chapter through `book::populate_in`, using a fixture with a file that has two zero-execution functions. It then asserts these things about the initial output:
- The file button carries `aria-expanded="false"`.
- The detail row is emitted as `class="gap-detail-row" id="habeas-gap-file-0" hidden`. That is the initial collapsed state of the per-file obligation details.
- The rows for `fn[a]` and `fn[b]` exist inside that hidden row.

The helper `exercise_file_click` runs the emitted click handler in node, with every generated row starting `hidden: true`. It checks that the click expands the row, so the collapsed state is the one that toggles open. That covers the parent requirement `requirements.test-coverage.index.gaps.details` and its toggle behavior. I did not assess that requirement's own tests here.

I read the renderer `impl[GapDirectory<'_>]/fn[render]` in `src/execution_coverage/book.rs` only through a search snippet. It emits `hidden` unconditionally on every `gap-detail-row`. A fixture with a single file therefore represents the whole input class, and a case with several files adds no distinct obligation.

The `!accepted.contains("class=\"gap-accepted-group\" open")` assertion concerns the accepted-exceptions group. It is not needed for this requirement.

I found no gap and no acknowledgments were needed.

text: In the combined gaps overview, clicking a listed file MUST expand or collapse
its uncovered obligations in place. Each expanded file MUST show each
obligation's source item and source location, measurement, and explanation
